extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '43011000') for tariff lines and 6-digit codes without dots (e.g., '430219') for subheadings. Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN (e.g., '4301.10.00') and NNNN.NN (e.g., '4302.19') per project schema.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Main Notes', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Product Description and Export Policy', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Notes 1 and 5 begin with 'Throughout this Schedule' — phrasing that elsewhere indicates section-scope notes. Per WCO HS nomenclature, Section VIII has NO section notes; these definitions are issued at chapter level in the Indian ITC(HS) Schedule and the PDF lists them under the Chapter 43 'Main Notes' table. They are therefore captured as chapter_notes (not section_notes), matching the Chapter 42 extraction precedent for the same section.
Note 2 sub-clauses are lettered (a)-(f) and the PDF skips no letters; this differs from Chapter 42 (which used '(ij)'). All six exclusions are captured as discrete entries in exclusion_clauses.
The 'Notification Date' and 'Notification No' columns in the Main Notes table are empty for all five chapter notes — null preserved.
Unit-of-measure column is NOT shown in this chapter's PDF — unit field set to null for all tariff lines.

The 'Export Policy' column distinguishes 'Free' from 'Prohibited' for several tariff lines (e.g., 4301.10.00 mink — Prohibited; 4303.10.10 wild-life-protected — Prohibited; 4303.10.20 CITES species — Prohibited; 4302.19.40 Tiger-Cat — Prohibited). These statuses are preserved verbatim. No 'Restricted' or 'STE' policies appear in this chapter PDF.
No 'Policy Condition' notification texts are populated for any Chapter 43 tariff line — the policy condition column is empty for every row. policy_conditions array is therefore empty.

Heading 4304 has its 8-digit codes structured under a single 6-digit subheading '4304.00'. The PDF renders this as '430400' (subheading) with three tariff lines underneath ('43040011', '43040019', '43040020'). Normalized accordingly.

Tariff codes in heading 4301 use the WCO HS subheading-skip pattern: 4301.10 (mink), 4301.30 (lamb), 4301.60 (fox), 4301.80 (other), 4301.90 (parts). Subheadings 4301.20, 4301.40, 4301.50, 4301.70 are absent from the schedule by design (matching the WCO HS 2022 nomenclature). Each present subheading is rendered as an 8-digit tariff line ending in '.00' rather than as a distinct subheading container — captured per the PDF presentation as direct tariff_lines under heading 4301 with a synthetic subheading wrapper for each.
PDF page count: 4 pages total. Page 1: title + Notes 1-5 (top portion). Page 2: tail of Note 5 only. Page 3: heading 4301 + start of 4302. Page 4: remainder of 4302, all of 4303 and 4304.

chapter_notes.text: Throughout this Schedule reference to "furskins", other than to raw furskins of heading 4301 apply to hides or skins of all animals which have been tanned or dressed with the hair or wool on.

This Chapter does not cover : (a) birdskins or parts of birdskins, with their feathers or down (heading 0505 or 6701); (b) raw hides or skins, with the hair or wool on, of Chapter 41 [See Note 1(c) to that Chapter]; (c) gloves, mittens and mitts, consisting of leather and furskin or of leather and artificial fur (heading 4203); (d) articles of Chapter 64; (e) headgear or parts thereof of Chapter 65; or (f) articles of Chapter 95 (for example, toys, games, sports requisites).

Heading 4303 includes furskins and parts thereof, assembled with the addition of other materials, and furskins and parts thereof, sewn together in the form of garments or parts or accessories of garments or in the form of other articles.

Articles of apparel and clothing accessories (except those excluded by Note 2) lined with furskin or artificial fur or to which furskin or artificial fur is attached on the outside except as mere trimming are to be classified in heading 4303 or 4304, as the case may be.

Throughout this Schedule, the expression "artificial fur" means any imitation of furskin consisting of wool, hair or other fibres gummed or sewn on to leather, woven fabric or other materials, but does not include imitation furskins obtained by weaving or knitting (generally, heading 5801 or 6001).
